title: Vital Essentials Freeze Dried Dog Treats | Beef Liver, Single Ingredient | Premium Quality | Grain Free Training Treats for Dogs, 2.1 oz Bag

reviews.title: Picky Dachshunds Approved
reviews.body: I purchased these treats as a replacement for another freeze-dried liver treat that I normally buy but was unavailable. My two dachshunds can be surprisingly picky when it comes to treats, so trying a new brand is always a bit of a gamble.Fortunately, these were an immediate hit. Both dogs were excited as soon as I opened the bag and eagerly accepted them during training and as rewards throughout the day. The treats break apart easily if you need smaller pieces, which is helpful for training sessions or smaller dogs.I also appreciate that these are made from a single ingredient—beef liver—with no grains, fillers, or unnecessary additives. The pieces looked fresh, and the bag arrived well sealed.If you have picky dogs or are looking for a simple, high-protein treat, these are worth trying. Based on my experience, they’ll be staying on my shopping list even after my usual brand becomes available again.

reviews.title: Vitamin packed dog food unique formula.
reviews.body: As a food personally it doesn’t work for my dog because she doesn’t like her dry food turned wet. I find this to be a really good food for traveling. It’s lightweight and you can just add water to fluff it up. Nit unlike oatmeal that we eat. Personally I Found it a little Rich for my dog. She did get a little diarrhea from it, but the content qualities is definitely there. The kibble smells like real food. I’ll admit she had no problem enjoying it. I was using it to mix with her old food - she didn’t complain lets’ just put it that way, But like with all new  foods it’s trial and error. Dr. Marty promises to be delivering the very best of the best for Dog foods. I personally feel whenever you have good nutrition in the contents it’s gonna be a good mix for your dog. I would think dogs with sensitive stomachs might have a little trouble. That’s the problem with my standard poodle dog. She has an extremely sensitive stomach. This food being organic doesn’t have a long shelf life once you open it. I keep it in the refrigerator just to preserve its natural qualities. Once open it does have an expiration date which I think was two weeks. The one upside is you don’t need as much because it is very concentrated. And when you add water, it really does fluff up so you get a lot more in the dog food than you think you’re getting in the the bag, it doesn’t look like much content. But follow the directions. Just think of it like instant oatmeal for humans and how it expands when you add water and prepare it. Same idea. It’s the same concept except for its vitamin packed vitamins and minerals interesting concept.

reviews.title: Easy to chew for senior pups
reviews.body: My senior pup loves these freeze dried treats. He is at a stage where really strong, tough treats are difficult for him to chew. So to find a freeze dried treat makes my dog mom heart feel at ease. I can toss him a few of these and have no worries about him chewing them. I will say they smell horrendous, but they must taste good because our pup gobbles them up. They are also in nice bite size little pieces so even if they don’t get fully chewed they will dissolve quickly.
